notes.title: Version 0.3.0 - Random Events
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Version 0.3.0 introduces new random events that will bring even more chaos and fun. There will be total 5 random events and they will be randomly triggered during the match. 

These events are:

[h3]Meteor Shower[/h3]
Meteors will rain down from the sky and destroy everything they collide with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470978/e3a6f46bc88f9b0138f1e5eb72c843ba5e7bf36a.png[/img]

[h3]Storm[/h3]
During this event Tornados will spawn at random positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470978/04a6fe56dac4534009e387d70e204f0ba9250b9d.png[/img]

[h3]Fog[/h3]
Fog will appear and block your vision. This can also be a good time to save your teammate from the prison.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470978/36ea573ad8b5fbd0a430b3c244ef06a45849f532.png[/img]

[h3]Madness[/h3]
Some Npcs will enter Madness state and they will begin to attack everyone. They will be stronger than usual in this state so be careful if they attack you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470978/10d71201e84bd58fe86567fd2fdd48002457fe54.png[/img]

[h3]Mystery Box[/h3]
Mystery Boxes will spawn at random positions throughout the map. Each box contains different things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470978/5177dc395e9e9de887e4c275b1fdba6d02070c16.png[/img]

New Items:
- Gravity Orb
- Boot
- Boxing Glove

Thank you for playing Mayhemers. If you have any questions, you can write in Steam Discussions.

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 - New Game Mode: Chaos Race
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added a new game mode Chaos Race: 

Chaos Race is a game mode where your only goal is to earn as many chaos points as possible before the time runs out. In this game mode everyone is a Mayhemer and everyone is your opponent. Stop your opponents and earn more chaos points than your opponents. After the time ends, the player with the highest chaos points will win the match.

[*] Some items in the map now reset after a duration. (Pickups, Destructables, etc.)
[*] Bombs, Grenades and Smoke Grenades now activate automatically after being thrown.
[*] Stun Gun's stun duration and cooldown has been reduced.
[*] Minimap has been removed.
[*] Added a Seed Changer button to the lobby interface. It will generate a new seed every time you return to lobby. You can disable/enable this option by clicking it. It is enabled by default.
[*] Temporary Imprisonment option in the lobby settings is now enabled by default.
[*] Added a sound effect that plays when you try to use an item that is not available to use.
[*] Added new sound effects for some interactions.
[*] Ignited Torch on the ground now burns objects upon contact.
[*] Fixed "TRUE MAYHEMER" achievement bug where it is not updating correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where player inputs were incorrectly disabled under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes get stuck on the loading screen after creating a lobby.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 0.1.1[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a distance filter to the lobby browser to show nearby lobbies and lobbies worldwide.
[*] Added a "No Lobby Found" message to the lobby browser when no lobbies are available
[*] Fixed a bug where fire vfx is not getting destroyed
[*] Fixed a bug where the speed of the car was incorrect
[*] Fixed a bug where player inputs were incorrectly disabled under certain circumstances
[/list]
[b]Note: Filtering global lobbies may increase latency, as it will filter all lobbies worldwide.[/b]


Thank you for playing Mayhemers. If you liked the game, don't forget to give a review.

notes.title: Demo Update - Public Lobbies
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thanks for playing the Demo. With this update players can now create public lobbies and find other lobbies to play with others.

If you have any feedback or bug report feel free to write in Steam Discussions.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Public lobby type
[*] Added a Find Game option to the Main Menu
[*] The Robot Arm no longer pulls objects while returning
[*] The Robot Arm's pull speed has been reduced from 40 to 30
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where thrown objects deal damage when they are on the ground
[*] Fixed issue where players cannot sit correctly
[*] Fixed jump animation while idle and holding an item
[*] Fixed issue where NPCs do not go inside the Bank Vault
[*] Fixed issue where the Robot Arm does not pull correctly
[*] Fixed issue where the Robot Arm pulls through objects
[*] Fixed issue where players were unable perform any actions due to the Lobby Interface
[*] Fixed the missing letters in some languages
[/list]
